warnings: This is a Zn fertilization study, not a CO2 study - the meta-analysis context appears mismatched
Complex factorial design with N rates × cultivars × foliar treatments - need to carefully identify the Zn control
The paper includes soil Zn application (30kg ZnSO4·7H2O ha−1) in ALL plots, so there is no true zero-Zn control for soil application
Foliar treatments have a clear control (deionized water) vs Zn treatments
Multiple Zn-related outcomes reported - need to extract grain Zn concentration specifically
LSD values provided - these are variance measures
Split-split-plot design with interactions - some data may be presented as interaction effects

WARNING: VAR-UNCLEAR - Variance type not clearly stated
recon.variance_source: ans were compared by Fisher's protected least significant difference (LSD)at P ≤0.05,0.01,or 0.001.SPSS soft
recon.control_definition: For foliar treatments: 'foliar spray of deionized water as a control'. Note: ALL plots received 30kg ZnSO4·7H2O ha−1 to soil
recon.treatment_definition: Foliar treatments: (2) ZnSO4·7H2O (0.4%, w/v) and (3) ZnSO4·7H2O (0.4%, w/v) + sucrose (3.0%, w/v)
recon.potential_tc_confusion: High risk - all plots received soil Zn, so this is comparing foliar Zn addition vs no foliar Zn, not true zero-Zn control
recon.sample_size_source: split-split-plot design with three factors...in four replicates
recon.factorial_structure: ["N application rate (3 levels)", "cultivar (4 levels)", "foliar spray treatment (3 levels)"]
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract grain Zn concentrations from Tables 2 and 3. Control = 'Deionized water' foliar treatment, Treatments = 'ZnSO4·7H2O' and 'ZnSO4·7H2O + Sucrose' foliar treatments. Use LSD0.05 values as variance measure. Note this compares foliar Zn addition vs no foliar Zn (all plots had soil Zn). Extract each N rate and cultivar separately if needed for completeness.
